method: Nearest-pixel readback of fixed projected world masks in the full beauty frame; linear sRGB luminance (0.2126,0.7152,0.0722). Pool x=-1..5 step .25, z=-2..2 step .25, excluding radius <=1 m around the courier; y=.05. Shadow x=1+.2*i for i=0..14, z=-.25+.125*j for j=0..4; beside the same x at z=+-1. Hue is HSV of mean sRGB in shadow samples darkened >=35% against the same scene with only the caster hidden. All masks/thresholds are identical before/after.
